title: Tartan woven from a thread-count sett in 2/2 twill
purpose: Generate tileable maps of tartan and plaid cloth from a sett: a reflected sequence of colours and thread counts used for warp and weft, woven in 2/2 twill so every crossing shows the warp or weft colour along diagonal lines. Use for kilts, scarves, blankets, flannel shirts and upholstery.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python tartan_sett.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: repeats
parameters.meaning: Whole sett repeats across the tile.

parameters.name: thread_scale
parameters.meaning: Multiplies every thread count; larger values show finer threads in the same stripes.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Height of the yarn and the twill ridges.

parameters.name: fuzz
parameters.meaning: Wool fuzz blurring colours and relief.

parameters.name: yarn_variation
parameters.meaning: Colour variation from thread to thread.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Highland check: navy and green grounds crossed by red with a yellow overcheck.

presets.name: grey_dress
presets.description: Dress sett in white, grey and black with a fine charcoal line.

presets.name: autumn_plaid
presets.description: Brown, rust and cream plaid with a narrow orange stripe, soft and fuzzy.

presets.name: buffalo_check
presets.description: Two-colour red and black block check, two repeats across.

presets.name: madras_bright
presets.description: Bright cotton madras: pink, lime, yellow and sky blue, crisp and smooth.

limits: The setts are invented and do not reproduce registered tartans. Thread counts are kept low so a thread spans several pixels at 256 x 256, which makes the cloth look coarser than real tartan; raise `thread_scale` and the output size for finer cloth. Threads are idealized round yarns on a regular grid without crimp variation or weaving faults, and a sett whose repeat is not a multiple of four gets its first pivot widened to keep the twill seamless. Fuzz is noise and a blur. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Symmetric sett reflected about its two pivots
2/2 twill interlacing: warp on top where (i - j) mod 4 is below 2
Crossing colour from whichever thread lies on top
Round yarn cross-section with dips where a thread passes under
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
